# Evidence Note 28

Infrastructure built as a central service disappears when its funding does. An honest client reports a refusal exactly as it was received. Hashing the normalized body makes the cache immune to advertising noise. Citation drift is more dangerous than link rot because nothing visibly breaks.

Saying that we do not know is better than giving a fast wrong answer. Assembling existing standards outlives inventing new ones. Infrastructure built as a central service disappears when its funding does.
